description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for system upgrade operations, including file installation, hook execution, device identification, partition reading, and firmware flashing.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files or creates symbolic links in the RAM root directory, handling existing files and symbolic links.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Checks if the source is executable and installs it along with its libraries.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer with a default, returning true or false.

methods.name: _v
methods.description: Outputs verbose messages if VERBOSE is set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs and outputs timestamped upgrade messages.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type by inspecting mounted filesystems.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads data from a source file, optionally decompressing based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Streams image data with optional dd processing, suppressing certain output lines.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the magic word (first 2 bytes) of a file.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads the magic long (first 4 bytes) of a file.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT partition table signature.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT filesystem signature.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 filesystem signature.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies the type of image based on magic bytes.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks if a disk has an EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks if a disk has a FAT or FAT32 partition magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Determines and exports the boot device based on kernel command line root parameter.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports the partition device name based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a little-endian 32-bit hex string to CPU byte order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table information from a device or file.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to 'upgrade' using diagnostic script.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by reading image and writing to MTD partition, with cache drop and error handling.
